title: Glowing helicopter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7DF9FF' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7DF9FF' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bodyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FF6B35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E84A1A'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cabinGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#A8E6FF'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5BC8F5'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='40' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Main rotor blur -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='25' rx='42' ry='5' fill='#FFD166' opacity='0.35'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='25' rx='30' ry='3' fill='#FFE29A' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Rotor mast -->
  <rect x='47' y='24' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#FFD23F'/>

  <!-- Tail boom -->
  <rect x='62' y='50' width='24' height='7' rx='3' fill='#E84A1A'/>

  <!-- Tail rotor -->
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='53' rx='4' ry='9' fill='#FFD166' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='53' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#FFE29A' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Tail fin -->
  <polygon points='82,47 90,47 90,42' fill='#FF8C42'/>

  <!-- Main body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='55' rx='22' ry='15' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='50' rx='12' ry='6' fill='#FF8C42' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Cabin window -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='52' rx='11' ry='9' fill='url(#cabinGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='49' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#D4F5FF' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Skids -->
  <rect x='24' y='70' width='30' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FFD23F'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='68' x2='28' y2='70' stroke='#FFD23F' stroke-width='3'/>
  <line x1='48' y1='68' x2='50' y2='70' stroke='#FFD23F' stroke-width='3'/>

  <!-- Belly light -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='67' r='3' fill='#7DF9FF'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='67' r='5' fill='#7DF9FF' opacity='0.3'/>

  <!-- Sparkle stars -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#FFE29A'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#FFE29A'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='60' r='1' fill='#FFE29A'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='65' r='1' fill='#FFE29A'/>
</svg>
